visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a beautifully roasted eggplant dish, topped with melted cheese and a bright red cherry tomato. In a bottom-left inset, a man with long, dark, wavy hair wearing a maroon shirt holds two raw purple eggplants, speaking with an extremely excited facial expression. (2) A fork pulls a long, stretchy strand of white cheese from the center of the roasted eggplant. The man in the inset reacts with wide eyes and a shocked expression. (3) The man is shown full-screen in a modern kitchen with blue cabinets, taking a large bite from a fork. He winces and blows out air as if the food is very hot; fire icons appear around his head. (4) Close-up hands hold a single, large, plump purple eggplant against a wooden cutting board background. (5) The eggplant is shown sliced lengthwise into two halves, and then a knife cut a grid pattern into the flesh of each half. (6) The eggplant halves are placed in a pink ceramic bowl and drizzled with golden olive oil, followed by the man grinding black pepper over them. (7) A small white bowl is filled with sliced tomatoes, minced garlic, and olive oil, then sprinkled with dried green herbs. (8) The man holds a black tray with the prepared eggplant and tomato bowl, smiling at the camera. (9) After roasting, the eggplant flesh is mashed into a soft pulp with a fork inside its skin. The roasted tomatoes are also mashed into a chunky sauce. (10) The tomato sauce is spread onto the eggplant, covered in shredded white cheese, and garnished with a tomato slice. (11) The man tastes the final dish, closing his eyes in satisfaction, and then speaks directly to the camera while holding the plate.
